title: Retire the bbox_roadmap surface: unused rendering artifact superseded by graph-native concept/inquiry tracking
wanted_capability: Remove (or formally deprecate) the bbox_roadmap tool family and its store. Operator direction 2026-08-18: prospective concepts and inquiries pulled out of the gap log should live as vertices in the project reflective graph (a campaign-layer extension of the design graph, a pattern already proven in operator prior art elsewhere), tied to campaign initiatives and sourced designs, not in a separate roadmap store. Roadmap today is a web-facing rendering artifact that nothing uses: the store holds a single stale proposed item (roadmap-41532f5f, 2026-07-22), and project-scoped writes fail from non-checkout sessions (attachment_inactive: checkout authority root cannot be canonicalized) with no collector backchannel like the gap store has. Wanted: a deprecation path that (1) removes or gates the roadmap MCP surface, (2) migrates or retires surviving items, (3) drops the EdgeIndex Roadmap family or re-points it at graph vertices.
missing_primitive: graph-native prospective-work tracking (campaign/inquiry vertices) replacing the roadmap store
fallback_used: Abandoned a gap-to-roadmap migration mid-flight (2026-08-18 grounding pass, Blackbox Janny session); the 19 candidate gaps stay open in the gap store until a campaign-layer graph extension exists in this repo.
